comment: Design files of other formats as components (mitcad#1894), run where cli.import_ipt and cli.import_ipt_design_saved saved the two .ipt test parts as part.mitcad (a cube and a cylinder, aluminium, two base features) and designed.mitcad (a parameter, Sketch1 and Extrude1). The app's Import into this design: each a copy with its history named after its file, the second beside the first, the whole import one undo step.
The part's material comes along with its bodies.
One undo takes both components out.
